headline: Missouri-St. Louis hands Pittsburg State a rare defeat
dek: Days after holding Washburn scoreless, Pittsburg State conceded for just the fifth time in 25 matches to take only its second defeat of the season. Even with the loss, the program has won seventeen matches and scored 45 goals, leaving Washburn as the only other side to beat it.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: The drop from the top is steep rather than gradual: Washburn has more goals than Newman, Missouri Southern and Fort Hays State together.

wire.line: Washburn has won eighteen times and scored 54 goals, conceding just seven all season.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Four matches are past their date with no result; Missouri Southern is in all of them except Washburn's meeting with Baker.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Central Missouri has conceded eight goals in 22 matches while scoring 49.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Eighteen different players have scored for Pittsburg State.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Coryn Jespersen has seventeen assists for Central Missouri, to go with four goals.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Juliette Langlet has made 121 saves for Northeastern State and conceded eighteen goals.

last_match.line: Pittsburg State had beaten Missouri-St. Louis in its season opener and had lost only to Washburn before this match.

next_match.line: Nebraska Kearney enters the spring without a win since early October.
